_comment: Upgrade-freeze policy per image repository, read by bin/refresh-vulns.sh to set
artifact.frozen on each finding. A frozen package is one the image pins in place,
so a fix existing in the repos does NOT make the finding patchable on a running
node — the supported remediation is rebuilding the golden image, and the portal
must not count it as actionable.
This file exists because the mirror is shared by several builders whose freeze
policies genuinely differ, so there is no correct global regex. Each builder owns
one entry, copied from the FREEZE_MARKER_REGEX / FREEZE_PKG_REGEX pair in its own
scripts/supply-chain.conf — the same two values its build-time vuln-pipeline.sh
uses, so a report refreshed here matches the one published at build time.
markerRegex identifies a frozen IMAGE from its SBOM: the freeze role only runs
where the accelerator stack is installed, so the driver's presence is the policy
bit. The daily re-scan walks SBOMs by digest and has no tag to consult.
pkgRegex names the packages the freeze covers.
repoRegex is matched against the mirror directory name; the first entry that
matches wins. A repository matching no entry gets frozen:false on every finding,
which is the behaviour this file replaced — so a builder that has no freeze policy
(or has not added itself yet) is unaffected by its existence.
Keep each entry in sync with its builder's supply-chain.conf. Drift shows up as a
build-time report and a refreshed report disagreeing about the same digest.
